record_text:
Key points.
Active threat: Run, Hide, Fight. Run if you can; hide silently if you cannot; fight only as a last resort.

Procedure.
Run: escape the area, leaving belongings, and call emergency services when safe. Hide: lock and barricade doors, silence phones, stay quiet. Fight: as a last resort, act with others to disrupt the attacker. Tell: give responders your location and descriptions.
